title: LanReport v1 — the judgement of one real-LAN run against its LanPolicy: how many node pairs the policy required and how many stood proven on the wire, how many legs were observed and how many Y-050 fabric messages they carried in total, whether any leg's carriage was simulated, the counted refusals apart by reason, and the verdict — proven (every required pair on real carriage, TLS 1.3, fingerprints matching the enrolled Y-011 certificates, discovery unaided, traffic in both directions), simulated_only (the same shape over stand-in carriage), or incomplete (anything refused or missing) (Y-062)
